name: Thos. Moser Freeport Showroom
old_description: Located just two blocks north of L.L.Bean’s flagship store, our flagship showroom is a convenient and picturesque stop if you visit Maine. We restored a nineteenth-century home and furnished two full floors with classic and new Thos. Moser furniture designs and Maine artwork. An attached carriage house serves as our outlet annex, with unique designs that are immediately available for purchase.
about:
The Thos. Moser Freeport Showroom occupies a restored nineteenth-century home at 149 Main Street in Freeport, Maine, two blocks north of L.L.Bean’s flagship store. The company has not disclosed a founding date for this location, its ownership structure, or the names of its founders. The showroom is managed by Steve Wyman, who also heads the Customer in Residence (CIR) program.

The showroom presents two floors of Thos. Moser furniture designs alongside Maine artwork, with an attached carriage house serving as an outlet annex offering immediately available pieces. The facility provides scheduled consultations for both standard and custom furniture designs through the CIR program. Operating hours run Monday through Saturday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday noon to 5 p.m., with holiday closures observed. The showroom also hosts events such as the “On Display: Dedicated to Art” exhibition, which pairs paintings and prints with handmade wooden furniture through October 31, 2026.

The showroom serves visitors to Maine, including residential customers and design professionals seeking Thos. Moser furniture. A “Commercial Products” link on the company’s website suggests outreach to commercial clients, though specific industries are not detailed. The showroom’s primary role is to display and sell the manufacturer’s furniture rather than to produce it.
